name: Kai
source:
The protagonist of the story, who finds himself laying in the open of nowhere without his memories. Relatively studious, good at sports, and plays the violin, he seems to be able to do anything as he tries to rediscover himself at the mansion. His resourceful demeanor has net him the admiration of everyone in the mansion, but is this a good thing?

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
